text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy, I heard 
some lively voices.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Senpai, there's all kinds of stuff 
tangled in your hair. Like leaves, 
branches...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Something like this is nothing 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, it's definitely not fine... I mean, 
how did things even end up like this?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai, you fell into the pitfall 
trap you dug yourself, so I was really 
shocked...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, you were the one who was 
supposed to take the bait~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So that's why the back of your head is 
such a mess... I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer... Well, yeah. It was supposed 
to be over quickly, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City seems to be trying to fix Shinko 
Windy's hair. However, she appears to be 
struggling with it...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You should get styled all cool like a hero 
too, Windy-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph! Windy-chan is a villain, so who 
cares about being like a hero!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“Still, don't powerful villains need to 
look cool too?”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guh!? Th-that might be true, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I won't take up much of your time. 
...Though this tail really is something 
else...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to watch over Gold City for a 
while as she neatened up her hair and tail 
using scissors and styling products.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright... all done. You're good to go.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: O-Ooh...? It feels kinda smooth and silky?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I went ahead and trimmed off the damaged 
parts to tidy it up.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-Huhhh...? I see, I see...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... I like it! I might just let you 
play with it again!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
T-That's so awesome~! Getting styled by 
City-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so jealous of Windy-senpai and the 
others...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Sure, you guys come along too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"If you leave it like this, Biko and 
Windy-senpai are the ones who'll end up 
feeling awkward, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, as time passed, rumors spread, 
and it turned into an endless flood of 
people...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, this turned into a way bigger 
deal than I expected...!
choice_data_list: Let's hurry and call for help!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Are you serious...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm cheering for you, City-senpai! 
Carrotman said that a pinch is always a 
chance!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bite back against adversity! Grrr, rawr, 
rawr—!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I was the one who went and stuck 
my nose in your business in the first 
place, anyway."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...There, all done. How is it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... Amazing, even though I was 
struggling so much with frizzy hair...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's a good habit of yours, so I made 
adjustments to make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And so, yet another Umamusume was saved...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Great job out there, Senpai! You fought 
valiantly—you're a true hero!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, thanks. Well, I won't be 
doing it for a while though..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gold City said so in a tired voice, 
though she didn't seem entirely 
displeased."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see! Hang in there, City-senpai! I'll go 
call for backup, so please endure it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, one at a time! Anyone 
wanting a haircut, line up behind this 
line!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey! You over there! If the line 
bulges out, you'll block the walkway!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: City-san, I went ahead and prepared this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SHING!*)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I personally sharpened these scissors, so 
I can guarantee their sharpness. Please, 
make good use of them.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, why those two anyway?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo came chasing after Windy-chan! 
Saying something about some rule violation 
the other day~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Once I explained the reason, 
they both gladly agreed to help!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I-I see. I appreciate the thought, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: In the end, I'm the only one cutting it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With precise crowd management, sharp 
scissors, and lively cheering, Gold City 
managed to pull through somehow.
